title: Permitted obstructions within required setback areas
previewText: Above a height of 85 feet above curb level, a dormer shall be allowed as a permitted obstruction pursuant to paragraph (b) of Section 23-413 (Permitted obstruction in certain districts) provided that, along a wide street, or on a narrow street within 50 feet of a wide street the building shall contain special architectural expression lines at a height of 85 feet above curb level.
